sentences.en: I wish I could go to the party with you.
sentences.zh: 我真希望可以和你一起去参加聚会。

sentences.en: Each party shall consist of no less than fifteen people.
sentences.zh: 每个团体至少要有十五人。

sentences.en: I intend to take my position as a third party.
sentences.zh: 我打算以第三方的身份占据我的位置。

senses.zh: 聚会，派对；政党；当事人，参与者
